notes.title: Feature update - July 5th 2025
notes.notes:
Sortable sound list
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677739/04e8bc3fdd50c01fef9b62f1a60eac24cfc35da9.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677739/fbcd792693e6ed0460cb078181c83114cb7cbf8d.gif"]

Drag & drop sorting is now available for both the sound grid and quick action slots! Customize your layout exactly how you want—your board, your rules!


Color tags 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677739/05a5248a9d77f8d12f6b33d4ac01874eaba536a5.gif"]

You can now add colors to your sounds! Use colors to organize, customize, or just make your board pop—it's all up to you!
